description: Download the switch's own configuration backup (backup.swb, the file the web UI's Save Backup produces) into the server's SwOS folder. The file is MikroTik's opaque format: it restores only through restore_swos_backup or the web UI, on the same model. A switch on factory defaults has nothing to save. Writes a file on the server (owner-only), so it is audited like a write.

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: save_swos_backup
title: Save SwOS Backup
